summary: End-to-end verification of internal analytics system (tracking + backend-confirmed downloads + /admin dashboard) on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 6 test areas pass. One minor React console warning found (non-blocking).

issues: React key collision warning spams the console: three header cells use the literal 'Median' as their React key (headers array in Admin.jsx line ~354). Repro: open /admin after any events exist -> DevTools console shows 'Encountered two children with the same key, Median' warnings on every render. Fix: give each header a unique key (e.g., index or 'median-viewplan'/'median-plandl'/'median-viewdl'). No functional impact — table renders correctly.

action_items: Low priority: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx (Time To Download <thead> map), replace key={h} with a unique key (e.g., key={`${h}-${idx}`}) to eliminate the duplicate-key React warning for the three 'Median' columns.
critical_code_review_comments: analytics.py:105 — login lockout identifier is client.host+email; behind ingress client.host may be shared (proxy). Consider X-Forwarded-For. Not a blocker for internal admin, but 5-fail lockout can trap legitimate users on shared egress IPs.

analytics.py:117 — on every failed attempt, locked_until is overwritten (rolling 15 min from latest failure) which is correct, but the count is never reset by TTL, so once >=5 the account is locked from THIS IP forever unless the doc is deleted or 15 min passes AND another failed attempt refreshes locked_until. Current test cleared it manually. Consider TTL index or reset count when locked_until passes.

tracker.js:64 — trackProjectView dedupes per session using sessionStorage. Verified: reload in the same tab does NOT double-count (funnel showed exactly 1 PROJECT_VIEW per project after reload). Good.
analytics.py:186 — slug regex 'my-dream-[a-z]+' rejects digits/hyphens; fine for current project names but brittle if a future slug like 'my-dream-2' or 'my-dream-north-star' is added.
test_credentials: admin@mydreamprojects.in / Mdp@Admin#2026 (per review_request; NOT in /app/memory/test_credentials.md which incorrectly claims no auth exists — main agent should update that file).
